review_order: Original, then all ten full candidate PNGs individually; frozen before baseline, receipt, source or prior scores
observations: Hero conveys leaf-backed wooden mantis convincingly with green eyes and pale toothed sickles.
Side profiles reveal long uniformly curved cervical arch and comparatively low horizontal abdomen, less compact angular chest/head transition than original.
Face is narrow pointed mask with large flat green panels; original has a more integrated brow/cheek and fuller faceted eye volume.
Leaf fan is broad but straight brown perimeter ribs and repeated planar kite construction feel engineered compared with original folded irregular leaf masses.
Sickles are strong but smooth broad outer arcs and sparse large teeth simplify original jagged profile; limbs and thorax remain comparatively regular.
Back/top are useful geometry evidence, not directly supported reference views. Static stills do not establish animation readiness.
